description: Implementation of the CategoryService interface handling CRUD operations for categories, including file upload and deletion, and converting between entity and response models.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing categories, including adding new categories with images, reading all categories, and deleting categories along with their images.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new category with an uploaded image, saves it in repository, and returns a response object.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves all categories from the repository and converts them into response objects.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category by its ID, removes associated image file from storage, and deletes the record.

methods.name: convertToResponse
methods.description: Converts CategoryEntity object to CategoryResponse including item count.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts CategoryRequest object to CategoryEntity with a generated UUID.
